item.title: parallelly 1.25.0: availableCores(omit=n) and, Finally, Built-in SSH Support for MS Windows 10 Users
item.description: parallelly 1.25.0 is on CRAN. It comes with two major improvements: You can now use availableCores(omit = n) to ask for all but n CPU cores makeClusterPSOCK() can finally use the built-in SSH client on MS Windows 10 to set up remote workers availableCores(omit = n) is your new friend When running R code in parallel, many choose to parallelize on as many CPU cores as possible, e.g. ncores <- parallel::detectCores() It’s also common to leave out a few cores so that we can still use the computer for other basic tasks, e.
